title: LUMA Brain: A Language Model From Scratch
short_desc: The brain behind LUMA — a small, fast language model I am building from the ground up, following Sebastian Raschka's "Build a Large Language Model (From Scratch)", to eventually run Luma locally on my own data and skills.
blueprint_desc: Working chapter by chapter through the book to implement every piece myself instead of calling a hosted API: tokenization and data loading, self-attention and multi-head attention, the GPT-style transformer block, pretraining on unlabeled text, and fine-tuning for classification and instruction following. The goal is a lightweight model that is easy on CPU/GPU, trained on my own data and on Luma's tools and skills, so the assistant can answer and act fully offline. The source code is currently private.
